content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I need to reset my password. I can’t remember it.
No problem. Please go to our secure portal at reset.company.com and click on 'Forgot Password.'
I’m on the page now. It’s asking for my username.
Great. Enter your company email address or your assigned username in that field and hit 'Next.'
Done. Now it wants my employee number.
Go ahead and type in your employee ID. This helps verify your identity.
Okay, entered. It sent a code to my email.
Perfect. Please retrieve that code from your email inbox and enter it on the portal to proceed.
Just did that. Now it’s letting me set a new password.
Excellent. Create your new password, making sure it’s at least eight characters with a mix of letters and numbers. Let me know once you’re finished.
